study.question: Does summing repeated categorical context IDs before measuring gradient conflict preserve useful auxiliary context transfer more effectively than occurrence-space projection, norm-only attenuation, or joint learning?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g3-r0026-context_field_project click AUC 0.6662307831, field_norm 0.6662276729, global_project 0.6662091329 and joint_control 0.6662241275 are effectively tied at the current single seed (field projection minus joint = 0.0000066556). This gives no persuasive evidence for the prior geometry. Yet shared/live context in g3-r0023-context_shared_live (0.6662458901) outperformed shared/detached (0.6659481623), and positive-only/negative-only context transfer in g3-r0025 fell to 0.6647485962/0.6651540446 versus both 0.6662241275. Thus discarding whole loss polarities is unsupported. Source inspection establishes that r0026 computes dot products between occurrence VJPs; the actual independent categorical table update first sums occurrences with the same field code. Cross-occurrence terms can reverse the conflict sign. Provisional mechanism: coalesced per-table geometry detects auxiliary conflict that occurrence geometry misses while retaining both label polarities. Occurrence conflicts and actual coalesced conflicts have not been measured in this dataset; this is an implementation-level limitation and a prospective mechanism hypothesis, not an observed biological/statistical cause.

nearest_work.difference: PCGrad section2.3/Algorithm1 inspected in original primary full text. It symmetrically projects individual task parameter gradients against other tasks, with task ordering. This study is a deterministic one-sided adaptation: preserve click, aggregate the three auxiliary BCE gradients, project only independent context tables, and inject an equivalent zero-valued loss surrogate without wrapping the host optimizer. Summing repeated embedding codes recovers parameter coordinates; it is correctness of the coordinate system, not claimed algorithmic novelty. No PCGrad reproduction or transferred performance claim. Section2.2 also warns that conflicting gradients alone need not be harmful; local curvature/dominance conditions were not measured here.

Author TensorFlow source read, particularly compute_gradients/proj_grad; source is mutable master, not a pinned reproduction artifact. It flattens parameter gradients and adjusts them in an optimizer wrapper. No source is imported, installed or executed here. Candidate preserves the frozen optimizer and changes the context derivative through a scalar hook.

Primary abstract only: auxiliary gradients weighted by similarity to the main task. Candidate removes a conflicting component in coalesced context-table coordinates instead of globally weighting task losses. Full-method equivalence and originality remain unverified.

Primary abstract only: MetaBalance adapts auxiliary gradient magnitudes per shared network part relative to target magnitude. The current norm control matches the projected auxiliary norm, not target norm; it isolates magnitude effects from directional correction. No claim of full MetaBalance reproduction.

Exact archived primary section4.3 and5.1 read. Target-conditioned unnormalized pooling is inherited with four-task/field adaptations. Current study changes only training gradients on context tables, without adding a pooling mechanism or claiming exact original DIN replication.

Exact coalescing is restricted by constructor guards to independent equal-width trainable plain nn.Embedding context tables, without feature encoders, max_norm or frequency-scaled gradients. Actual feature-map compliance is pending host preflight.

Read ancestor source and committed receipt. Retain exact forward helpers, initialization and probability-clamped BCE convention, replace only statistic coordinates and add ID caching. Matched occurrence control recovers the prior field-projection rule; repeated-ID aggregation adds no capacity.

study.proposed_difference: For each context field, obtain p_i=dL_click/dcontext_i and a_i=d(sum auxiliary BCE)/dcontext_i. Exclude declared padding rows; treat zero/OOV as ordinary learned codes otherwise. Use torch.unique plus index_add only on batch-present field codes to form P_v=sum_{i:code_i=v}p_i and A_v=sum a_i. Set c=min(<P,A>,0)/||P||^2 (zero if primary mass zero). Coalesced projection adds -c*p_i at each occurrence, yielding exactly A_v-c*P_v after embedding backward. Norm control uses s=||A-cP||/||A|| in [0,1] and adds (s-1)*a_i; it matches projected aggregate auxiliary norm while preserving auxiliary direction. Occurrence control uses the exact prior field-wide occurrence projection. Joint adds zero. All four calculate every contrast statistic. Two forward caches (context and categorical codes) are consumed/cleared in loss and reset at every new forward; inference computes no gradient statistics. Geometry is Euclidean before Adagrad, not a guarantee on adaptive updates or future generalization.
predictions: Integrity prediction: all four initial/eval prediction functions, BCE scalar values, parameter counts and module buffers match the r0026 ancestor. At an identical training state, all non-context parameter derivatives and the unmodified click-context derivative match joint BCE before host clipping.

Geometric prediction on host preflight: summing final occurrence derivatives by repeated IDs gives primary P plus A-cP for coalesced_project; <P,A-cP> is nonnegative per table up to floating-point error. Norm-control aggregate auxiliary norm matches projection and keeps A direction. Unique IDs without padding recover the occurrence coefficient. Repeated-ID scalar constructions can reverse the occurrence/coalesced conflict sign.

Predictive hypothesis: coalesced_project exceeds same-round joint, occurrence_project and coalesced_norm in full validation click AUC, while its four task AUC/Logloss and measured costs reveal tradeoffs. A gain >=0.0001 over each same-round control and exceeding the incumbent is a follow-up prioritization threshold, never a significance test.

Use existing fixed history slices (empty,1-16,17-64,>64) with sample/positive/negative counts and inadequate-slice flags; slice effects remain exploratory. If allowed host outputs expose training-only gradient diagnostics, report conflict-sign disagreements and removed norms by field; do not assume such outputs exist or infer their values from AUC.
falsifiers: Constructor guards fail on the actual feature map, host loss/cache contract fails, or source-equivalent controls diverge in initial function/other-parameter derivatives: stop before full training and record execution failure separately from scientific counterevidence.

Coalesced projection fails exact table-gradient/nonnegative-dot or norm-matching checks under repeated IDs, declared padding, zero norms or actual BF16 execution: implementation is falsified, with charged diagnostics retained.

If coalesced_project is tied with or worse than joint/occurrence controls, no local predictive support for coalescing as a remedy. A tiny difference like r0026 remains inconclusive and is not success.
If coalesced_norm matches any gain, directional-conflict explanation is unsupported; auxiliary attenuation or optimizer interaction remains plausible.

If actual conflict signs never disagree or coalesced corrections are zero, the proposed missing-conflict explanation is unsupported locally even though the coordinate identity is mathematically valid.

Any favorable single-seed result remains preliminary until paired repetitions and feasible user-cluster uncertainty checks; one unsuccessful implementation does not refute all task-conditioned sharing mechanisms.
alternative_explanations: Existing differences are single-seed observations after many adaptive rounds; seed noise, accumulated validation selection bias and BF16 rounding may dominate small effects.

Adaptive Adagrad coordinate scaling and history of accumulators can undo Euclidean alignment; nonlinear trajectories and curvature prevent a nonnegative precondition-free dot product from guaranteeing better click predictions.
Aggregate auxiliary BCE may hide conflicts between cart/fav/buy; this study intentionally retains the aggregate used by the prior projection rather than claiming per-task protection.

Rare/high-frequency context IDs contribute differently after summation. This intended coordinate change also changes effective emphasis; coalescing controls cannot establish that every changed update is beneficial.

Explicit padding has zero table derivative and is excluded only from coalesced statistics; its inclusion in the inherited occurrence control is part of the coordinate contrast. A later padding-only diagnostic could be needed if padding drives any effect.

Context block need not be the remaining bottleneck; prior selector transfer was null and shared positional gradient projection g3-r0017-position_gradient_project (0.6641686829) remained below primary-only (0.6655179496). These abandoned branches constrain optimism without refuting all projection rules.

Released auxiliary labels concern user/category/brand over24h rather than ad-specific conversion, and official_offline delayed feedback may not be mature online. No production point-in-time or causal conversion claim is supported.
